title: # First patch: completion and harness improvement evaluation
summary: Tested on 12 October 2026 with Ollama 0.40.3, a two-CPU quota, 8 GiB RAM, and no exposed GPU. The model was Ornith 1.5 9B at Q4_K_M. These are single runs at temperature 0.6, not estimates of general model reliability. Native replies without tool calls previously became `needs_input`, including replies reporting successful work. The patch requires explicit `finish` calls and uses the existing two-retry repair loop. Checklists are optional ordinary `todo.txt` files written with `write_file`; the dedicated `update_todo` tool has been removed. The hosted connection probe uses a temporary JSON configuration and preserves the saved native preference.
